title: workload.deployment.describe v1 request data
description: Synchronous request for the current observed state of a workload. Core NATS, at-most-once: THE RESPONDER MUST BE IDEMPOTENT because the requester retries on timeout and cannot distinguish a lost request from a lost reply. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the object lives in.

includeConditions.description: Include the workload's status conditions in the reply. Default false; a reply is bounded by `limits.max_event_bytes` like any other message.
